verdict.rationale: Capacities' docs describe block-based linking and block references, which let you link to individual blocks inside an object and reference them on other pages. They also state that an embedded block is identical to the original, so edits appear everywhere the block is used. That covers both transclusion and live sync. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of section-level (multi-block or heading) transclusion, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sync behavior.
